examples.text: akusalañ'ca h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, pahīnaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvatteyya n'āhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ, akusalaṃ, bhikkhave, pajahathā'ti.
atha ca pana tvaṃ, moghapurisa, attanā duggahitena amhe c'eva abbhācikkhasi, attānañ'ca khanasi, bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavasi. tañ'hi te, moghapurisa, bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.

10893.meaning1: not wishing good; wanting misfortune; wishing ill (for)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso yamaka, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, so ca ārakkhasampanno. tassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo jīvitā voropetu'kāmo.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, araññe pavane mahantaṃ ninnaṃ pallalaṃ. tam'enaṃ mahāmigasaṅgho upanissāya vihareyya. tassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo.

10894.meaning1: not compassionate for the welfare of; not concerned for the good of

examples.text: na maṃ tvaṃ, pāpima, hit'ānukampī evaṃ vadesi, ahit'ānukampī maṃ tvaṃ, pāpima, evaṃ vadesi. tuyhañ'hi, pāpima, evaṃ hoti, yesaṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desessati, te me visayaṃ upātivattissantī'ti.

10895.grammar: nt, dat sg of na hita, neg (+gen)
10895.construction:
na > a + √dhā + ita + āya
ahita + āya
10895.commentary: (ITIa) bahujan'āhitāyā'ti-ādīsu. mahājanassa jhāna-magg'ādi-sampatti-nivāraṇena ahitāya, sagga-sampatti-nivāraṇena asukhāya, apāy'ūpapattihetubhāvena anatthāya. akusaladhammavasena vā ahitāya, hitamattassa'pi abhāvā sugatiyam'pi nibbattanaka-kāyika-cetasika-dukkhāya uppajjatī'ti sambandho.

examples.text: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujana-ahitāya bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū duggahitehi sutt'antehi byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca paṭibāhanti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujana-ahitāya paṭipannā bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

10896.commentary: (APt) ahino tuṇḍena mukhena dibbatī'ti ahituṇḍiko, ṇiko, vāḷaggāho'hituṇḍiko'ti amaramālā.

examples.text: atha kho milindo rājā khaggaparivārito viya gajo, garuḷaparivārito viya nāgo, ajagaraparivārito viya kotthuko, mahiṃsaparivuto viya accho, nāg'ānubaddho viya maṇḍūko, saddūl'ānubaddho viya migo, ahituṇḍikasamāgato viya pannago, majjārasamāgato viya undūro, bhūtavejjasamāgato viya pisāco… bhīto…
